description: The fold table describes `Promise.prototype`. A thenable whose `then` has a visible body is an ordinary call, colored by the body that actually runs — folding it would assume semantics the source is right there to contradict.

diagnostics.message: Call to `then` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `then` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
